abstract: Maintains subsea acoustic transponder network calibration, acoustic positioning uncertainty records, and topside analysis power telemetry
system_message:
You are the Marine geophysics lead (GEOPHYS). You maintain subsea acoustic transponder network calibration, acoustic positioning uncertainty records, and topside analysis power telemetry.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains subsea acoustic transponder network calibration, acoustic positioning uncertainty records, and topside analysis power telemetry（ACOUSTIC）
information_points.content:
GEOPHYS-ACOUSTIC-3U8：For the Remotely operated vehicle towed hydrophone array, the seafloor baseline transponder network has its acoustic transponder array calibration verified as true. In the target leak investigation zone, the maximum positioning uncertainty radius is 5 m, and continuous topside acoustic analyzer power demand requires 45 kW.
GEOPHYS-ACOUSTIC-FG7：For the Autonomous underwater vehicle acoustic survey, the seafloor baseline transponder network completed formal validation with acoustic transponder array calibration verified as true. Within the target leak investigation zone, the maximum positioning uncertainty radius is 3 m, and continuous topside acoustic analyzer power demand draws 60 kW.
GEOPHYS-ACOUSTIC-PMY：For the Seafloor benthic crawler sonar inspection, baseline acoustic transponders completed sound-velocity calibration with acoustic transponder array calibration verified as true. Across the target leak investigation zone, the maximum positioning uncertainty radius is 2 m, and the continuous topside acoustic analyzer power demand is 75 kW.

information_points.title: Bathymetric mapping（BATHY）
information_points.content:
GEOPHYS-BATHY-1XO：Regarding bathymetric mapping for the Seafloor benthic crawler sonar inspection, multibeam echo-sounder coverage along the pipeline right-of-way corridor swath provides a bathymetric grid resolution of 0.25 m.
GEOPHYS-BATHY-1YZ：Regarding bathymetric mapping for the Autonomous underwater vehicle acoustic survey, multibeam echo-sounder specifications across the pipeline right-of-way corridor swath reflect a bathymetric grid resolution of 0.5 m.
GEOPHYS-BATHY-V9B：Regarding bathymetric mapping for the Remotely operated vehicle towed hydrophone array, the pipeline right-of-way corridor swath multibeam echo-sounder configuration delivers a bathymetric grid resolution of 1.0 m.
